title: AlloyDB: `edition` deprecated, `expressConfig` on Backups
summary: The `edition` field on AlloyDB `Cluster` and `Backup` resources is now deprecated, directing developers to use `expressConfig`. A new `expressConfig` property has been added to `Backup` resources as an output-only field.
details: The `edition` property, previously used to specify cluster editions, is now deprecated on both `Cluster` and `Backup` schemas, including its enum values. Developers should transition to using the `expressConfig` property, which was recently introduced for `Cluster` resources, to manage Express cluster configurations. For `Backup` resources, a new `expressConfig` property has been added. This field is output-only (`readOnly: true`) and reflects the Express configuration of the cluster from which the backup was created. If your automation or code attempts to set `expressConfig` on a `Backup`, it will now fail as it is not configurable.
